verses.sloka: ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणः सुताः ।निर्युयुर्भवनात्तस्मात् सप्त सप्तार्चिवर्चसः ।। ५.४५.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste rākṣasendreṇa coditā mantriṇaḥ sutāḥ ।niryuyurbhavanāttasmāt sapta saptārcivarcasaḥ ।। 5.45.1।।।।

translations.english: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
translations.hindi: भयङ्कर विक्रम सम्पन्न हनुमानजी, मेघनाद के उस बन्धन रूप कमं से विस्मित हो, क्रोध से लाल नेत्र कर, रावण को देखने लगे

translations.english: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
translations.hindi: उस समय महातेजस्वी रावण बड़ा मूल्यवान्‌ श्रौर मोतियों से जड़ा हुआ चमचमाता मुकुट धारण किए हुए था

translations.english: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
translations.hindi: उस समय रावण शरीर को जिन श्रद्भुत भूषणों से भूषित किए हुए था; वे सब सुवणं केथे श्रौर उनमें हीरे तथा बड़ी मूल्यवान्‌ मणियाँ जड़ी हुई थीं वे ऐसे सुन्दर थे, मानो मन लगा कर बनाए गये थे

translations.english: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
translations.hindi: रावण मल्यवान्‌ रेशमी वस्त्र पहिने हुए था तथा उसके शरीर में लाल चन्दन लगा हय़ा था । वह विविध प्रकार के सुगन्धियुक्त कस्तूरी केसरादि शरीर में लगाए हुए था

verses.sloka: जनन्यस्तु ततस्तेषां विदित्वा किङ्करान् हतान् ।बभूवुः शोकसम्भ्रान्ताः सबान्धवसुहृज्जनाः ।। ५.४५.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: jananyastu tatasteṣāṁ viditvā kiṅkarān hatān ।babhūvuḥ śokasambhrāntāḥ sabāndhavasuhṛjjanāḥ ।। 5.45.5।।।।

translations.english: Their mothers and relatives and their friends were struck with grief when they learnt about the kinkaras killed.
translations.hindi: उस समय वह अत्यन्त दर्शनीय हो रहा था । उसके भय उपजाने वाले लाल-लाल नेत्र थे। उसके पैने और बड़े-बड़े दाँत साफ होने के कारण चमचमा रहे थे । उसके म्रोंठ लम्बे थे

translations.english: The barnished golden ornaments worn by them were shining as they brushed shoulders with one another (eager to fight first) to attack Hanuman who stood waiting at the main archway.
translations.hindi: परम तेजस्वी वीर रावण, अनेक सर्पों से युक्त मन्दराचल के शिखर की तरह, झपने दस सिरो से शोभायमान हो रहा था

verses.sloka: सृजन्तो बाणवृष्टिं ते रथगर्जितनिःस्वनाः ।वृष्टिमन्त इवाम्भोदा विचेरुर्नैर्ऋताम्बुदाः ।। ५.४५.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: sṛjanto bāṇavṛṣṭiṁ te rathagarjitaniḥsvanāḥ ।vṛṣṭimanta ivāmbhodā vicerurnairṛtāmbudāḥ ।। 5.45.7।।।।

translations.english: They went roaring with their chariots rattling, sending forth torrents of arrows like the stormy clouds thundering.
translations.hindi: उसके शरीर का रङ्ग नीले अंजन की तरह था और छाती के ऊपर हार शूल रहा था । उसका मुखमण्डल पूर्णिमा के चन्द्रमा के समान था । उस समय वह, प्रातःकालीन सूर्य को ढके हुए मेध की तरह जान पड़ता था

translations.english: Later, Hanuman covered with showers of arrows scattered all over appeared like the king of mountains shot with showers of rain.
translations.hindi: डाहुभिबंद्धकेयूरेश्चन्दनोत्तमरूषितैः आजमानाङ्कदेः पीनः पञ्चशीर्षे रिवोरगः ।। ८ उसकी मोटी मोटी मुजाएँ, जिन पर चन्दन लगा हुआ था और जो केयूरों तथा बाजूबंदों से भषित थीं, पाँच मुखवाले भयङ्कर सर्पो की तरह जान पड़ती थीं

verses.sloka: स शरान् मोघयामास तेषामाशुचरः कपिः ।रथवेगं च वीराणां विचरन् विमले ऽम्बरे ।। ५.४५.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa śarān moghayāmāsa teṣāmāśucaraḥ kapiḥ ।rathavegaṁ ca vīrāṇāṁ vicaran vimale 'mbare ।। 5.45.9।।।।

translations.english: Then the monkey moving fast in the clear sky rendered the arrows of the giant heroes and speeding chariots futile.

verses.sloka: स तैः क्रीडन् धनुष्मद्भिर्व्योम्नि वीरः प्रकाशते ।धनुष्मद्भिर्यथा मेघैर्मारुतः प्रभुरम्बरे ।। ५.४५.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ krīḍan dhanuṣmadbhirvyomni vīraḥ prakāśate ।dhanuṣmadbhiryathā meghairmārutaḥ prabhurambare ।। 5.45.10।।।।

translations.english: Sporting in the sky with the giants who held bows in their hands, Hanuman shone like the powerful Windgod sporting in the sky surrrounded by rambling dark clouds.
translations.hindi: क झासूषणों से सुसज्जित स्त्रियां चमर श्रौर बिजन हाथों में लिए उसके चारों ग्रोर खड़ी हुईं; उसकी सेवा कर रही थीं

verses.sloka: स कृत्वा निनदं घोरं त्रासयंस्तां महाचमूम् ।चकार हनुमान् वेगं तेषु रक्षस्सु वीर्यवान् ।। ५.४५.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ trāsayaṁstāṁ mahācamūm ।cakāra hanumān vegaṁ teṣu rakṣassu vīryavān ।। 5.45.11।।।।

translations.english: Valiant Hanuman making terrific sound and frightening the army of ogres marched swiftly.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर परामश देने में निपुण चार मन्त्री थे, जिनके नाम दुर्धर, प्रहस्त, भहापाइवे श्र निकुंभ थे

verses.sloka: तलेनाभ्यहनत् कांश्चित् पादैः कांश्चित् परन्तपः ।मुष्टिना ऽभ्यहनत् कांश्चिन्नखैः कांश्चिद् व्यदारयत् ।। ५.४५.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: talenābhyahanat kāṁścit pādaiḥ kāṁścit parantapaḥ ।muṣṭinā 'bhyahanat kāṁścinnakhaiḥ kāṁścid vyadārayat ।। 5.45.12।।।।

translations.english: The scorcher of enemies, Hanuman hit some ogres with his palm, some with his feet and some with his fist and pierced some with his nails.
translations.hindi: श्रन्य बड़े बलवान राक्षस भौ उसके समीप बैठे थे । मंत्रियों के बीच बैठा हुआ रावण, चौर समुद्रों से घिरी समूची पृथिवी की तरह जान पड़ता था

verses.sloka: प्रममाथोरसा कांश्चिदूरुभ्यामपरान् कपिः ।केचित्तस्य निनादेन तत्रैव पतिता भुवि ।। ५.४५.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: pramamāthorasā kāṁścidūrubhyāmaparān kapiḥ ।kecittasya ninādena tatraiva patitā bhuvi ।। 5.45.13।।।।

translations.english: The monkey strangled some with his chest and some between his thighs. A few fell down dead on the ground hearing his roaring noise.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार मन्त्रकुशल मम्त्रियों तथा श्रन्य हितेषियो से सेवित रावण देवताश्नों से सेवित इन्द्र की तरह जान पड़ता था

verses.sloka: ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु भूमौ निपतितेषु च ।तत्सैन्यमगमत्सर्वं दिशो भयार्दितम् ।। ५.४५.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣvavasanneṣu bhūmau nipatiteṣu ca ।tatsainyamagamatsarvaṁ diśo bhayārditam ।। 5.45.14।।।।

translations.english: Struck by fear on seeing Hanuman, the seven sons of ministers dropped down dead on the ground, and their army fled in all the ten directions.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, महातेजस्वी रावण को उस समय एस शोभा ह्‌ रही है, जैसी मेशशिखर पर, जल से पूर्ण मेष की शोभा होती है

verses.sloka: विनेदुर्विस्वरं नागा निपेतुर्भुवि वाजिनः ।भग्ननीडध्वजच्छत्त्रैर्भूश्च कीर्णा ऽभवद्रथैः ।। ५.४५.१५।।।।

translations.english: The elephants trumpeted discordantly out of fear, the horses fell down on the ground and even the chariots with seats, parasols and flag staffs broken were strewn all over the ground.

verses.sloka: स्रवता रुधिरेणाथस्रवन्त्यो दर्शिताः पथि ।विविधैश्च स्वरैर्लङ्का ननाद विकृतं तदा ।। ५.४५.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: sravatā rudhireṇāthasravantyo darśitāḥ pathi ।vividhaiśca svarairlaṅkā nanāda vikṛtaṁ tadā ।। 5.45.16।।।।

translations.english: Streams of blood flowed and Lanka was filled with many kinds of horrifying sounds of cries.
translations.hindi: स तैः संपीड्यमानोऽपि रक्षो भिर्भीमविक्रम: । विस्मयं परमं गत्वा रक्षोधिपमवेक्षत ।। १४ यद्यपि भयंकर विक्रम सम्पन्न राक्षस हनुमानजी को उत्पीड़ित कर रहे थे, तथापि हनुमानजी राक्षसराज रावण को देख कर बड़े विस्मित हुए ॥ १५ भ्राजमानं ततो दुष्ट्वा हनुमान्राक्षसेश्वरम्‌ । मनसा चिन्तयामास तेजसा तस्य मोहितः

verses.sloka: स तान् प्रवृद्धान् विनिहत्य राक्षसान् महाबलश्चण्डपराक्रमः कपिः ।युयुत्सुरन्यैः पुनरेव राक्षसैस्तमेव वीरो ऽभिजगाम तोरणम् ।। ५.४५.१७।।
verses.transliteration: sa tān pravṛddhān vinihatya rākṣasān mahābalaścaṇḍaparākramaḥ kapiḥ ।yuyutsuranyaiḥ punareva rākṣasaistameva vīro 'bhijagāma toraṇam ।। 5.45.17।।

translations.english: Having killed the ogres who were old and strong, the valiant and mighty Hanuman, wishing to slay the other ogres advanced towards the archway. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: वाह इस राक्षसराज का कंसा सुन्दर रूप है, केसा धैय है? कंसा पराक्रम है झौर केसी कान्ति है? वाह! यह समस्त शुभ लक्षणों से भो सम्पन्न है
